claim: The deployed commit on oddfellow-letta-backend-v0206 is 1760892
resolution: sha256 of the live / and /command.html matched the repo blobs at 70c02b3 exactly, not 1760892. The handoff was right; this system's record was wrong.
cost: A wrong fact sat in the entry-point memory file for six days, and every session that read it inherited the error.

claim: The deployed commit on oddfellow-letta-backend-v0206 is 70c02b3
resolution: sha256 of live / and /command.html are byte-identical to the repo blobs at 70c02b3.

claim: pg_dump 15 cannot dump a PostgreSQL 18 server
resolution: Ran pg_dump 15.19 against a real PostgreSQL 18.6 server: 'aborting because of server version mismatch', and it left a 0-byte output file.

claim: An empty Render IP allowlist means the database is unreachable from outside
resolution: Render's docs state the default allowlist is 0.0.0.0/0 (allow all), so 'empty' is ambiguous: never-configured means already open, deliberately-removed means blocked. Both readings take the same action, so this was left open rather than guessed.

claim: The rehearsal instance serves the same code as the Render deployment
resolution: Both report version 0.20.6 and the rehearsal passes all four acceptance gates, but the rehearsal runs from the working tree while Render runs 70c02b3, and canonical is 122 commits ahead of that. Same version string is not the same code.
